description: This file defines a Java class 'ShippingEvents' that contains static methods for calculating shipping estimates, retrieving shipping origin addresses, and managing shipping-related data for an e-commerce system within the OFBiz framework. It handles external service integration for shipping costs, shipment time estimates, and associated utilities.

classes.name: ShippingEvents
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling shipping estimates, addresses, and related logistics functions in the OFBiz e-commerce framework.

methods.name: getShipEstimate
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimates for all shipping groups in the provided shopping cart, applying promotions afterward.

methods.name: getShipGroupEstimate
methods.description: Provides shipping estimate details for a specific shipping group, considering shipping method, address, and other parameters.

methods.name: getShipEstimate
methods.description: Overloaded method that computes shipping estimate for a given order helper and shipping group ID.

methods.name: getShipGroupEstimate
methods.description: Main method to compute shipping estimate based on multiple parameters, including shipping method, address, and allowances.

methods.name: getGenericShipEstimate
methods.description: Invokes a service to estimate shipment cost based on store shipping method and context.

methods.name: getShipmentCustomMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the custom shipment method service name based on a custom method ID.

methods.name: getExternalShipEstimate
methods.description: Calls an external service to estimate shipping costs via a configurable shipment gateway.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping origin address for a supplier, or falls back to a general location.

methods.name: getShippingOriginContactMechFromFacility
methods.description: Gets shipping address for a facility, preferring specific contact purposes.

methods.name: getGeoIdFromPostalContactMech
methods.description: Extracts geographic IDs from a postal address contactMech.

methods.name: getShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Retrieves estimated shipment times based on addresses or geographic IDs.

methods.name: getShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Gets shipment time estimates based on various conditions, including carrier and geographic IDs.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimate
methods.description: Finds the matching shipping time estimate for a given carrier shipment method.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Calculates the estimated number of days for shipping based on shipping method and estimates.
